skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the nature of leadership, differentiate between leadership and management, grasp the prerequisites for successful leadership, comprehend major approaches and theories of leadership, and apply various leadership styles effectively.
Develop skills in presenting and public speaking, negotiation, conflict resolution, and effective group work.
Work effectively in teams, organize and manage group tasks, evaluate the quality of work and group outcomes.
Understand and apply ethical principles in leadership, motivate and empower others, build feedback systems, and foster a positive organizational culture.
Develop strategic thinking, lead organizational change and innovation, and promote a learning organization culture.
Demonstrate independent work, take responsibility for personal and group tasks, solve practical management issues, and adapt to changes.
Act with a service-oriented spirit, social responsibility, and professional ethics.
